content.text: Health Canada's guidance is to start around 6 months, so Theo's window is about a month away. Look for signs he's ready: sitting with support, steady head, reaching for your food, and the tongue-thrust reflex fading. Until then, breastmilk or formula is still all he needs. When you start, make iron-rich foods the first thing you offer, like meat, lentils, or iron-fortified cereal. Confirm the timing with your provider.
